insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Jarvan IV is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Jarvan IV in 20/39 games (51%): 2 picks (0-2) and 18 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Azir? They go Ahri
insights.text: Azir is a G1 favorite (8/22 G1s, played by Poby). In the 10 later games where it was burned or banned, Poby went to Ahri (4/10) and Ryze (1/10).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Teams respect-ban Orianna against them
insights.text: Opponents banned Orianna against them in 20/39 games (51%).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they go about as deep as the league
insights.text: In 6 G3+ games, 14/30 picks (47%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 42%). Pool: 45 champs in G1s, 26 in G3+.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: They get stronger as the series goes deep
